description: This is a C source file implementing a driver for the ITE it8xxx2 tachometer sensor module in the Zephyr RTOS. It manages two independent tachometer counters, handles hardware register interactions, and provides functions for sampling and retrieving RPM data.

methods.name: tach_ch_is_valid
methods.description: Checks if the specified tachometer channel is valid based on hardware register status.

methods.name: tach_it8xxx2_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches tachometer sample data and updates internal capture value.

methods.name: tach_it8xxx2_channel_get
methods.description: Converts captured tachometer counts into RPM and returns via sensor_value.

methods.name: tach_it8xxx2_init
methods.description: Initializes the tachometer hardware, configures pins, and sets channel mode.
